qualification: The cited EO provisions establish separate functions or individual-office actions. None establishes the full statutory amendment/repeal/continuity history of section 411. EO12293 does not itself supply the actual underlying 1980 statutory transition. No source in this workpaper is promoted to proof of the unresolved first end.
savings_analysis: The original and EO12292 contain no target-specific saving. EO12293 creates separately sourced 1980 Act delegations and does not expressly revive EO9799. Statutory continuation, accrued or completed legal effects, and exact first cessation require the actual material Acts. No final none_after_bounded_search finding is retained.
earlier_position_abolition: EO10608 abolishes the German High Commissioner office; no target end or unverified convention date is assigned to the general Secretary classification delegation.
